name: io.github.pritas/actionforge
description: Expose an ActionForge account's dynamically-generated tools to any MCP client. Agents describe a computation; ActionForge generates, deploys, and invokes a deterministic serverless function — no code written by hand.

environmentVariables.name: ACTIONFORGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your ActionForge API key. Generate one from the ActionForge API or dashboard.

environmentVariables.name: ACTIONFORGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your ActionForge deployment. Defaults to the hosted service if unset.
